sec_ops: sanitization checklist (recommend):
1) Replace emails with [REDACTED_EMAIL] using regex.
2) Replace PAN-like numbers (12-19 digits) with [REDACTED_PAN].
3) Replace IPv4/IPv6 with [REDACTED_IP].
4) Replace person names with PERSON_# tags when possible.
5) Strip Authorization header / API keys entirely from bundles.
Tools: jq + sed, or a tiny python script. examples: 
```bash
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' input.json > scrubbed.json
sed -E 's/([0-9]{12,19})/[REDACTED_PAN]/g' scrubbed.json > scrubbed2.json
sed -E 's/((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)(\.|:)){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)/[REDACTED_IP]/g' scrubbed2.json > final.json
```
or a tiny python example: 
```python
import re
def scrub(s):
  s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", s)
  s = re.sub(r"\b[0-9]{12,19}\b", "[REDACTED_PAN]", s)
  s = re.sub(r"(\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b)", "[REDACTED_IP]", s)
  return s
```
Include a short manifest describing what you replaced (email->[REDACTED_EMAIL], name->[PERSON_1], ip->[REDACTED_IP]).
